paragraphs.text: Many schools now ask children to type most of their work, and some educators have proposed dropping handwriting lessons altogether. I think this would be a mistake, although not for the reasons usually given.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The romantic argument, that handwriting is a beautiful art that must be preserved, does not persuade me. Plenty of beautiful skills have disappeared without great loss. The stronger argument is practical: studies suggest that children who write letters by hand learn to recognise them more quickly than those who only type.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: At the same time, it seems pointless to spend hours on joined-up writing. Neat, readable print is enough for almost every purpose in adult life, and the time saved could be given to typing, which children will certainly need.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Examinations present a further problem. As long as many national exams are written by hand, pupils who rarely hold a pen will be at a disadvantage, and it is unfair to test them in a way they have not practised.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: I think this would be a mistake
items.prompt: The writer supports the proposal to stop teaching handwriting.

explanation.en: The writer calls the proposal to drop handwriting lessons a mistake: “I think this would be a mistake” → NO.
explanation.kk: Жазу сабағын алып тастау туралы ұсынысты автор қателік дейді: «I think this would be a mistake» → NO.
explanation.ru: Предложение отменить уроки письма автор называет ошибкой: «I think this would be a mistake» → NO.

items.prompt: The writer is persuaded by the argument that handwriting is an art worth preserving.

explanation.en: The writer opposes dropping handwriting, but the “beautiful art” argument “does not persuade” him. Supporting a conclusion is not the same as accepting every argument → NO.
explanation.kk: Автор жазуды алып тастауға қарсы, бірақ «beautiful art» туралы дәлел оны «does not persuade». Қорытындыны қолдау әр дәлелмен келісу деген сөз емес → NO.
explanation.ru: Автор против отмены письма, но аргумент про «beautiful art» его «does not persuade». Поддерживать вывод и соглашаться с каждым доводом — не одно и то же → NO.

items.quote: the time saved could be given to typing, which children will certainly need
items.prompt: The writer thinks children should be taught to type.

explanation.en: “the time saved could be given to typing, which children will certainly need” — the writer wants typing to be taught → YES.
explanation.kk: «the time saved could be given to typing, which children will certainly need» — автор теруді үйретуді ұсынады → YES.
explanation.ru: «the time saved could be given to typing, which children will certainly need» — автор предлагает учить печати → YES.

items.quote: Neat, readable print is enough for almost every purpose in adult life
items.prompt: The writer believes most teachers prefer marking handwritten work.

explanation.en: Nothing is said about teachers’ preferences: the text is about children, adult life and exams. The writer’s view on this is unknown → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мұғалімдердің не ұнататыны туралы мәтінде ештеңе жоқ: балалар, ересек өмір және емтихан туралы айтылады. Автордың бұл жөнінде пікірі белгісіз → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О предпочтениях учителей в тексте ничего нет: говорится о детях, взрослой жизни и экзаменах. Мнение автора об этом неизвестно → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: it is unfair to test them in a way they have not practised
items.prompt: The writer considers it unfair to make pupils write exams by hand if they rarely practise handwriting.

explanation.en: “it is unfair to test them in a way they have not practised” — the writer says plainly that it is unfair → YES.
explanation.kk: «it is unfair to test them in a way they have not practised» — автор мұны тікелей әділетсіз дейді → YES.
explanation.ru: «it is unfair to test them in a way they have not practised» — автор прямо называет это несправедливым → YES.

Write YES if the statement agrees with the claims of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the claims of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.
